name: Intersection of Stone St. and Crown St.
desc1: This is a cobblestoned street. It is dimly lit by guttering lanterns
desc2: hung from tall posts. It is relatively clean, and is quiet and fairly
desc3: unpopulated. The buildings here are plain-looking and unornamented,
desc4: but are well-made. Stone street's end is here, and continues to the
desc5: south, with Crown street crossing it to the east and west.
